data.narrative:
Artimus Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Acome, Shane Mitchell, Nick Kellaris, and Christoph Keplinger. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The valuation landscape includes 1 public comparable and 8 private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Given the early stage and limited public information, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using $5M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the robotics sector; while 11 same-sector peers exist broadly, fewer than 3 meet narrow stage or valuation-tier filters required for reliable benchmarking.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $14M (high), with a median of $12M. This range reflects the applied stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the strength of Artimus's proprietary technology relative to the competitive set, the composition and momentum of the founding team, and near-term revenue or customer traction not captured in this dataset. Additional financials and comparable transaction data would improve precision.
